previousUnapprovedDraft.title: The Bell — Babloo's Introduction
previousUnapprovedDraft.setupAndCut: Twins ke saath badminton outing ke baad Meenakshi ghar lautti hai. Usi evening Babloo ek sealed pharmacy parcel lekar aata hai. Doorbell bajti hai; Meenakshi ko pata chalta hai ki Babloo bahar hai. Episode 03 yahin cut. Na conversation, na touch, na flirting. Unka first proper encounter Episode 04 mein hoga.
previousUnapprovedDraft.ep04Handoff: First proper Babloo encounter, beginning only after the EP03 doorbell cliffhanger; no EP04 Babloo actions authored or approved yet.

beats.title: Unexpected meeting
beats.action: At around 6:45 PM the twins have just dropped Meenakshi after badminton. Babloo is arranging pharmacy parcels near Tower C. He catches the boys’ playful goodbye but is not involved in it.
beats.internal: The reader already knows Babloo as a society pharmacy helper; this is the first proper personal conversation with Meenakshi.

beats.title: First different look
beats.action: Babloo notices Meenakshi's loose hair, plum kurta’s hourglass silhouette, cheerful expression and softer-than-usual smile. His appreciative gaze holds for a moment and Meenakshi notices.
beats.internal: This differs from how he normally sees her at work; no hidden exposure or unwanted physical contact.

beats.title: Flirtation
beats.action: Meenakshi starts with a teasing question. Babloo responds with an unexpectedly confident compliment; she smiles and continues the playful exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: Kya hua, Babloo? Aaj pehchaan nahi paaye?

dialogue.speaker: Babloo
dialogue.line: Pehchaan toh gaya, Doctor Madam. Bas aaj aap kuch zyada hi khoobsurat lag rahi hain.

beats.internal: First clearly personal compliment; Meenakshi responds knowingly and playfully.

beats.title: Concern beyond appearance
beats.action: Babloo notices that Meenakshi's own car has not returned. She explains the car stopped working near the badminton court. He genuinely offers to help check or recover it tomorrow.
beats.internal: His concern goes beyond her appearance and gives their next interaction a distinct practical purpose.

beats.title: Closing hook
beats.action: Meenakshi agrees to Babloo's help with her car the following day. They part by the lift. She recalls his unusual confidence as she walks away, and Babloo remembers her positive response to his compliment.
beats.internal: EP03 Meenakshi viewpoint ends here; Episode 04 car-recovery scene is a potential next encounter, not already written.

summary: Two-paragraph established helper history followed by first direct personal encounter at Tower C after badminton; five approved plot beats, with first appreciative glance and teasing compliment, car breakdown connection, and tomorrow's help offer.
ending: Meenakshi accepts a future car-recovery help offer, leaves for the lift, and privately recalls his unexpectedly bold compliment. No second doorbell; no encounter deferred.
